title: MirrorGeometryNode preserves and reflects bezier handle slots
description: Current line 115 does GeometryBundle.ofMesh(result) which drops all slots. Fix: preserve input slots; for handle slots, duplicate and reflect handle vectors across mirror plane (mirror-axis component negates); rebuild arrays keyed by output edge IDs using CoonsHandleBuilder directed-map pattern.
definition-of-done: 1. Mirror preserves non-handle slots unchanged. 2. Handle vectors reflected correctly on mirror axis. 3. Output handle arrays sized for new edge count. 4. Fallback when no handles present.
testing-plan: 1. cube->assign_bezier_handles->mirror_geometry(X)->coons_patch produces bilaterally symmetric smooth mesh. 2. Mirrored handles are mirror images of originals.
